comment: No family is given for the two signal inputs or the eight outputs: the module copies voltages without looking at them. Outputs 0 to 3 are the left column top to bottom, 4 to 7 the right column top to bottom (VCS.cpp:307-313). While a signal input is empty nothing is written to that side's selected output, so it holds the last voltage it was given.
